title: pasania variolosa
intro: Pasania variolosa, commonly known as East Indian ash, is a plant species belonging to the family Meliaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Pasania variolosa include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-ulcerogenic properties, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of Pasania variolosa include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
